{{Quote|What others abandon, we protect.|Sector Rangers motto|<ref name="g11" />}}
The '''Sector Rangers''', officially the '''Corps of Rangers''' and later also called the '''Imperial Sector Rangers''' under the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], were a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] level [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] organization that was first established by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and was virtually unchanged under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==Description==
===Overview===
The Sector Rangers were established during the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] mandated the creation of a universal police agency, charged with apprehending criminals and keeping the peace, a concept duplicated in each sector of the Republic.<ref name="Pirates & Privateers" /> While local law enforcement agencies were restricted by jurisdictional boundaries, the Sector Rangers were able to pursue criminals anywhere within a given sector or even beyond to bring them to trial.

Although also operating alone, Rangers usually traveled in pairs or groups of four for particularly dangerous assignments.<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy">''[[Threats of the Galaxy]]''</ref> Often, they were organized in teams composed of the crew of a Ranger ship,<ref name="Pirates & Privateers" /> typically a small transport. As the Rangers often had to move quickly through space, they were also expected to be capable starfighter pilots.<ref name="Star Wars Gamer 8" />

[[File:Sector_Ranger_TotG.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A Sector Ranger takes cover behind an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]].]]
At the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a typical ship of the Ranger Corps was the [[Law-class light patrol craft|''Law''-class light patrol craft]], though the sections of the [[Bormea sector/Legends|Bormea]] and [[Darpa sector/Legends|Darpa]] sectors also used [[PB-950 patrol boat]]s and [[Regulator X-Q2 System Patrol Cruiser]]s.<ref name="The Far Orbit Project">''[[The Far Orbit Project]]''</ref> Around [[137 ABY]], armed transports of the [[Gladius-class light freighter|''Gladius''-class]] were their preferred long range scout vehicle.<ref name="Legacy Era Campaign Guide" />

In addition to their own ships and [[Droid/Legends|droid]] complements, Sector Rangers had the right to commandeer local policemen or make use of Republic or Imperial vessels in the course of their duties, although most avoided doing so unless the situation at hand required such draconian fault-prone methods. Rangers were trained to be cautious and methodical in their gathering of evidence or employment of their powers, so as not to have criminals be released due to legal loopholes and mistrials. Furthermore, authority figures being a stickler for red tape or reacting indignantly were not unheard of.

In systems that were not affiliated with the current galactic government or held it in poor regard, the Corps' enforcement powers, including the suspension of local officials, were of no avail, so the Rangers had to rely on their skills in negotiation or intimidation alone to get the help they needed on worlds like [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy" /> However, because the Sector Rangers had a reputation for fairness and aloofness from petty politics, most citizens spoke with them more willingly than officers of other law enforcement agencies.<ref name="Star Wars Gamer 8" />

===Special Enforcement Officers===
Considering the highly unusual circumstances that most Sector Rangers found themselves in, they could be in the company of almost any type of contemporaries&mdash;mercenaries, slicers and even gamblers&mdash;each possessing some unique skill that proved helpful to the Sector Ranger in bringing criminals to justice.<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy" /> In this spirit, Rangers were empowered to deputize a select number of civilians to act as legal agents for the duration of an investigation.<ref name="Star Wars Gamer 8" /> The Corps' [[Special Enforcement Officer/Legends|Special Enforcement Officers]] often worked alongside [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], though most SEOs chafed at the use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] of the latter, or their refusal to get involved in certain types of cases.<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy" />

Recruited from the best of the Sector Rangers, SEOs had wider arrest and detention powers, which allowed them to cross sector boundaries in pursuit of a wanted criminal without first requesting clearance from the bordering sector's Ranger branch (the normal procedure for members of the Corps).<ref name="The Far Orbit Project" />

[[File:Sector_ranger_cracks_down_on_ration_fraud.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Sector Ranger cracks down on a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] ration fraud.]]
Due to this high degree of autonomy and independence, it was not uncommon for SEOs to operate far from their nominal headquarters as their investigation led them across the known space.<ref name="Star Wars Gamer 8" />

Many SEOs went about their duties undercover, infiltrating the underworld to approach a delinquent. A comparatively famous example for this practice is Officer [[Narra Mesyne]], who impersonated a [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racer]] called Miraj and ended up winning many races over the course of her assignment. Many SEOs also specialized in anti-terrorist operations, hostage rescue and counter-espionage efforts. Because of their expanded jurisdiction, Special Enforcement Officers would sometimes lead teams of other Rangers dedicated to one or more of these particular types of crimes.<ref name="g11" />

Sometimes the higher ranking SEOs rubbed the regular Rangers the wrong way when they used their position to take over an investigation or pull a Ranger off his case to assist the SEO's own. Nevertheless, most Special Enforcement Officers were held in regard and represented the ultimate goal for a Sector Ranger to eventually attain through years of service.<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy" />

Because of adventure possibilities exemplified by cases like that of the aforementioned Officer Mesyne, many [[Holodrama/Legends|holodramas]] featured a SEO pursuing an adversary across the length and the breadth of the galaxy, perhaps driven by a personal involvement in the crime, or the fulfillment of some private passion.<ref name="Star Wars Gamer 8" /><ref name="g11" />

The Sector Rangers also shared and maintained a database of known criminals and suspected agents of criminal groups.<ref name="Secrets of Naboo">''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''</ref>

==History==
Since their formation the Sector Rangers were concerned with law enforcement and peacekeeping matters and not military or political issues. In the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Republic Office of Criminal Investigations/Legends|Republic Office of Criminal Investigations]] was the Corps' governing body.<ref name="Star Wars Gamer 8" />

The Rangers tried to put an end to the trade of [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]], but they survived the best efforts, even those of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="Zygerrian Takedown">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030724takedown|text=Zygerrian Takedown|int=Zygerrian Takedown}}</ref>

With the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] engaged in the fighting of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], policing and enforcing ration regulations had fallen to the Sector Rangers.<ref name="Star Wars Insider 67">{{InsiderCite|67|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 14:4:14}}</ref>

They remained largely unchanged during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] era except in name, then referred to as the Imperial Sector Rangers. In this time, [[Sector Ranger Central Command]] was administered by the transformed [[Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations/Legends|Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations]] (IOCI), which was itself answerable to the Justice branch of the [[Coalition for Progress/Legends|Coalition for Progress]], part of [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR]].<ref name="Pirates & Privateers" />

[[File:Sector_Ranger_G8.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A [[Gender/Legends|female]] Sector Ranger.]]
At least two Imperial Sector Rangers, [[Dyyz Nataz]] and the [[Diollan]] [[Spurch Goa]], became [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. They were relieved of duty because they had blown a palace asteroid of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] into pieces, causing a scandal.<ref name="Dark Empire Sourcebook">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] an attempted larceny by [[Cecil Noone]]'s robber band resulted in a messy shootout between their bulk freighter ''[[Borogove]]'' and a Sector Ranger patrol boat, stranding the thieves in the [[Kamar Badlands]]. The criminals made the repairs to their ship in time to end the awkward situation.<ref name="Star Wars Adventure Journal 15">{{JournalCite|15|The Great Herdship Heist}}</ref>

[[1 ABY/Legends|In the following year]] and at the behest of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Landric]], the Imperial Office of Criminal Investigations (IOCI) assigned [[Inspector/Legends|Inspector]] [[Zanza Gata]] to bring the art thief known only as the "[[Tanda Marelle|Tombat]]" to justice. IOCI Director [[Jacen Corbit]] introduced the experienced [[Special Enforcement Officer/Legends|Special Enforcement Officer]] to a packed room of reporters in a dramatic press conference on [[Danteel]].<ref name="Star Wars Adventure Journal 8">{{JournalCite|8|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>

Before [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], a Ranger of the [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith sector]] named [[Fenn Gilbrantes]] encountered the dreaded [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Salmakk]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and survived the confrontation.<ref name="Rough and Tundra: Adventure Settings and Scenarios for the Greater Javin">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040325adv|text=Rough and Tundra|int=Rough and Tundra}}</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Moff [[Irnst Stavveld]] instructed the [[Sector Ranger Central Command]] to detail an additional patrol to the [[Induparan Crown Worlds]] area, after [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Mirash Peet]] had requested support in view of increasing [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] activities in the region, chiefly due to the exploits of [[Urias Xhaxin]] and the crew of the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Free Lance]]''.<ref name="Pirates & Privateers" />

On [[Stend VI]], [[Special Enforcement Officer/Legends|Special Enforcement Officer]] [[Narra Mesyne]] was hunting the [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] criminal [[Kaylo NaKuda]]. Over the course of her assignment, she took an alias, participated in [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop races]] and rapidly gained fame at [[The Pits (cantina)|The Pits]].<ref name="Wretched Hives of Scum and Villainy">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Brahle Logris]] tried to murder a Ranger on [[Gandalla]]. He was convicted and sent to prison after a unit of Sector Rangers tracked him down and arrested him at gunpoint.<ref name="g11" />

In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], a Sector Ranger captured [[Iquar]] from the [[Karazak Slavers' Cooperative/Legends|Karazak Slavers Cooperative]] and extracted a confession revealing [[Seland' Ir]] as the mastermind behind the kidnapping of [[Janissa Locrin]].<ref name="g11" />

In the course of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was torn apart to form the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], and the Sector Rangers inevitably followed suit. Following the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|Liberation of Coruscant]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] reorganized the Sector Rangers within the New Republic into the [[New Republic Security Force]]. In addition to enforcing common law, it was hoped that this new organization, consisting of many ex-Rangers, could end the activities of the [[Palpatine Counter-Insurgency Front]].<ref name="g11" /><ref name="X-Wing: The Krytos Trap" />

During [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]], the leader of the [[One Sith]] made sure to put the Sector Rangers under direct Imperial control, much like over hundred years ago under [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] rule. Members of the Corps acted with a jurisdiction rivaled only by the Sith Lords in charge of the Empire.<ref name="Legacy Era Campaign Guide" />
